name: Float-over topsides
description: Fully integrated and pre-commissioned deck transported on a barge, floated over the substructure and lowered by ballasting or quick-drop mechanisms (or by deballasting a floating substructure). Avoids heavy-lift crane capacity limits. Primary source: https://pdfcoffee.com/offshore-platform-topside-pdf-free.html

specifications.basis: 11,970 t integrated topsides installed by floatover
jacket designed for floatover transfer of topsides weight directly to four leg rows with added bracing
